research_attempts.query_text: Spyridon S Varthis; NARA OSS index and official Archives context; CIA Reading Room or equivalent official-source context; exact-name and meaningful variants; OSS, Army, rank, branch and assignment clues; employer and occupation 1940; obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, Library of Congress and archival searches; Boxes 800-802; protected identifiers used only in private official-record comparison
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, search snippets, unsourced genealogy, commercial people-finder pages, relatives, postwar-only leads and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier, rank or personnel-file bridge were rejected. Historical occupation categories and military assignments were not silently converted into employers.
research_attempts.research_notes: Reviewed official, institutional or contemporary evidence produced the identity, occupation, employment or military-assignment outcome recorded in the bundle. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain and archival searches were checked as applicable. The index, Army bulk evidence, code list, Smithsonian and Syracuse finding aids, 1945 Broadcasting notice, declassified CIA field-report index, Library of Congress newspaper page and Maryland State Archives affidavit were inspected directly where relevant. No search-result snippet was used as sole final evidence, no paywall or access control was bypassed, and no authenticated NARA Catalog API call was made.
